literal: Gain weighing, affection speaking, of the character women, benefit weighing, without befriending, should leave.
translation: One should evaluate the true worth of women who speak of affection only after calculating their material gain, and leave them without forming any friendship.
modern: கிடைக்கும் பயனை ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்துப் பிறகு அன்பாகப் பேசும் குணம் கொண்ட பொதுமகளிரின் உண்மைத் தன்மையை ஆராய்ந்து அறிந்து, அவர்களோடு நட்பு கொள்ளாமல் விலகிவிட வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against associating with mercenary women who simulate affection solely for material gain. The poet describes them as those who first calculate the profit ('payan tūkki') and only then speak words of love or virtue ('paṇpu uraikkum'). A wise person must carefully evaluate the true nature and consequences of such relationships ('nayan tūkki') and completely avoid befriending them ('naḷḷā viṭal'). The repetition of the verb 'tūkki' (weighing or evaluating) highlights the contrast between their cold calculation of profit and the wise person's careful evaluation of character.
